title: The Flower That Warms Itself
short_teaser: Some plants can generate heat, helping spread scent or protect reproductive structures.
story: Some plants can generate heat, helping spread scent or protect reproductive structures. Life can use strategies that seem almost mechanical. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Life can use strategies that seem almost mechanical. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen.
